text: “Nor do I understand,” said he, “that any doubts tend towards you, my dear. Much suspicion may exist without that connexion.” “With the lawyer,” I returned. “But two other persons have come into my mind since I have been anxious. Then I told him all about Mr. Guppy, who I feared might have had his vague surmises when I little understood his meaning, but in whose silence after our last interview I expressed perfect confidence.” “Well,” said my guardian. “Then we may dismiss him for the present.
